title: What Are You?
summary: A new neighbor moves in and Paddy and Billy employ every shibboleth they know to determine his religion, only to discover the deeply anticlimactic truth.

scenes.visual: Wide shot of Belfast terraced street as a moving van pulls up to the empty house between Paddy and Billy's homes. Camera slowly pans to show both men peering suspiciously from their respective windows.
scenes.narration: A new arrival threatens the delicate ecosystem.

scenes.visual: Medium two-shot of Paddy and Billy at their garden fence, both looking toward the new house with intense curiosity and slight suspicion.

dialogue.line: Right, what d'you think he is?
Hard to tell from the furniture.

scenes.visual: Close-up on a plain doormat being placed at the new house's entrance. Camera pulls back slightly to reveal Paddy and Billy crouched behind a car, studying it intently.
Medium shot of Paddy gesturing dramatically while Billy takes notes in a small notebook. Both men look like amateur detectives discussing a case.

dialogue.line: No flags, no team colors, nothing!

scenes.visual: Quick montage-style shot of Paddy and Billy separately approaching the new neighbor Derek, who is unpacking boxes. Camera switches between their suspicious faces.
Medium two-shot of Paddy standing awkwardly next to Derek who is holding a box. Paddy's face shows intense concentration as he prepares his test question.

dialogue.line: So... how do you say aitch?
Um... aitch? Why do you ask?

scenes.visual: Medium two-shot of Billy standing stiffly next to Derek, who looks increasingly confused. Billy has his notebook ready and looks like he's conducting an interrogation.

dialogue.line: What do you call this city?

scenes.visual: Close-up on both men's frustrated faces as they realize their tests have failed. Both look genuinely puzzled and slightly defeated.
Medium three-shot with Derek in the center looking bemused while Paddy and Billy flank him, both leaning in with expectant expressions waiting for his answer.

dialogue.line: Just tell us - what are you?

scenes.visual: Wide shot of Paddy and Billy back at their fence, both holding cups of tea and looking deflated. They stare into the distance with expressions of profound disappointment.
scenes.narration: Some mysteries are too mundane to solve.
